turnout.notes: North Dakota turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native eligible-voter turnout artifact is collected and reconciled. North Dakota does not require voter registration; the official SOS dashboard reports eligible voters instead of a registered-voter denominator.
